item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Geo-redundant backup and restore for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Geo-redundant backup and restore is now generally available for Azure HorizonDB. It lets you store backups in a geo-redundant way and restore a HorizonDB deployment in another Azure region when needed.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Fusion is being expanded with additional models, broader availability across Copilot surfaces, and benchmark results published on two public Terminal-Bench leaderboards. The update also gives users more options for comparing Fusion performance.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Some Git over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication
item.description:
GitHub says that during periods of unusual traffic, some public repository clones and fetches over HTTPS may temporarily require authentication to protect github.com availability. The change is temporary and only affects some operations when the site is under load.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GPT-6 Astra is generally available in GitHub Copilot
item.description:
GPT-6 Astra from OpenAI is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. GitHub says the model is intended for long-horizon, autonomous coding and agentic tasks.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Reopening Copilot Business and Enterprise signups
item.description:
GitHub is gradually reopening sign-ups for Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise for customers paying by credit card or PayPal over the next few weeks. Availability is rolling out gradually to people who have been waiting to start.

  • Source: GitHub
